title: Finite-group Fourier coefficient
statement: For a finite abelian group $G$, a real-valued function $g$ on $G$, and a real-valued additive character $\psi$ on $G$, the finite additive Fourier coefficient of $g$ at $\psi$ is their inner product with respect to the uniform measure on $G$.
hypotheses_covered: $\psi$ is an additive character from $G$ to $\mathbb R$
